pins.title: Fluffy Baked Egg & Sausage Breakfast Pan | Easy Turkish Breakfast Recipe 🍳
pins.description:
A soft, delicious Turkish-style breakfast pan made with eggs, milk, and flour — loaded with colorful bell peppers, sausage (sucuk), and melted cheese. Perfect for busy mornings or a family brunch! 🧡 Quick to prepare, easy to bake, and full of flavor!

Bake Time: 15 minutes at 190°C (375°F) on the lowest rack of the oven for an evenly baked, golden top and perfectly cooked bottom.
Pro Tip: Always use baking paper to prevent sticking and achieve the best texture.



Ingredients :

2 cups milk

2 eggs

1 tsp salt

pins.title: 🥜🍫 Peanut & Chocolate Bonbons – Creamy, Keto-Friendly & Freezer-Ready! By: @chiara.fiorani
pins.description:
📊 Estimated Macros (per bonbon, est. – makes 5):
Calories: ~60 | Fat: ~5 g | Protein: ~2.8 g | Net Carbs: ~1.5 g

Ingredients (Makes 5 bonbons):
⅔ cup full-fat Greek yogurt (150 g)
1 tbsp peanut butter (15 g)
1 tbsp cocoa powder (8 g)
Keto-friendly sweetener, to taste (I used sugar-free maple syrup, about 1–2 tsp / 5–10 ml)
Topping:
Sugar-free dark chocolate, melted (about 1 oz / 30 g)

Instructions:
In a bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and sweetener until smooth.
Spoon or shape the mixture into bonbons and place them on a parchment-lined tray.
Freeze for at least 4 hours, until fully firm.
Dip the frozen bonbons into the melted sugar-free dark chocolate.
Return to the freezer or fridge until the chocolate sets, then enjoy! 🫶🏼
. #chocolatebonbons

How to Apply Sticky Tabs for Press-On Nails (Natural & Long-Lasting Fit 💅)
pins.description:
Want your press-on nails to look salon-perfect and stay on longer? 💅 Learn the proper way to apply sticky tabs for a secure, natural-looking fit. Start with nail prep—push back cuticles, file the surface, and clean thoroughly. Choose the right size sticky tab and apply it carefully (not too close to the cuticle). Warm it with a hair dryer for 10 seconds, then press and activate the adhesive. Finally, place your press-on nail slightly above the cuticle, gently roll it down, and hold for 10 seconds for a strong, flawless finish.

pins.title: Savory Butter Delight: French Onion Tart
pins.description: b'Savory Butter Delight: French Onion Tart Recipe  Ingredients:  1 sheet puff pastry  2 large onions (thinly sliced)  2 tbsp butter  1 tbsp olive oil  1 tsp sugar  1 tsp salt  1/2 tsp pepper  1/4 cup heavy cream  1/2 cup grated Gruy\xe8re cheese  1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese  Fresh thyme (optional)  Method:  Preheat oven to 375\xb0F (190\xb0C). Roll out puff pastry on a baking sheet.  In a pan, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat. Add onions, sugar, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are caramelized (15-20 mins).  Add heavy cream to onions and cook for another 2-3 mins.  Spread onion mixture on pastry, sprinkle with cheeses.  Bake for 20-25 mins until golden and crisp. Garnish with thyme.  Serve warm and enjoy this rich, buttery treat!'

pins.title: Crockpot pumpkin spice hot chocolate
pins.description:
Whether you’re cozying up on the couch or hosting for the holidays, this easy pumpkin spice hot chocolate recipe should be your go-to treat. All you need are six ingredients & a crockpot to whip up this delish homemade drink:
 • (Serves 12)
 • 24 oz. milk chocolate chips
 • 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
 • 2 Tbsp. pumpkin pie spice or extract
 • 5 cinnamon sticks
 • 1 gallon of your milk of choice

As many marshmallows as your heart desires

Throw all your ingredients into the crockpot & cook on high for a minimum of two hours. Garnish with marshmallows plus a sprinkle of your fave spice, then you’ve got an easy (but impressive) treat to serve all season long!
